operations.prompt:
Regenerate ALL EIGHT commercial city building sprites in the supplied first reference into a new cohesive, refined, detailed miniature art sprite sheet. The second reference is the authoritative orthographic camera guide. REPLACE every building with newly painted artwork, preserve the clearly recognizable identities and general period architecture, but give each richer brick/stone/wood textures, crisp roof shingles, small practical facade fittings, weathering, restrained planting, legible doors and windows, and tasteful muted natural color. Painterly realistic transport tycoon miniature assets, softly hand painted, not cartoon, not glossy toy/plastic, no thick outlines. Northwest illumination, short subtle contact shadows. TAIGA temperate finish with restrained deep green planting.
MANDATORY GEOMETRY: true fixed 2:1 dimetric orthographic view. Ground edges and all horizontal architectural edges on the two perpendicular axes follow exactly +26.565 degrees and -26.565 degrees to the screen, two horizontal pixels for one vertical pixel. Upright vertical corners. BOTH front and side facades must visibly follow these axes, no nearly frontal facades, no perspective convergence. Match the cube guide camera, remove the guide from final. Building roof pitches are natural but roof ridges/eaves use the ground axes. All eight buildings share the same viewing angle.
OUTPUT: square high-resolution 3-by-3 atlas sheet on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Each object completely isolated in its own equal square cell, centered horizontally, entire silhouette contained with at least 35 pixels of transparent gutters from ALL cell boundaries, no overlapping neighboring cells, no grids, no captions. Eight objects ONLY. Last bottom-right cell entirely empty. Objects have individual small irregular ground/contact planting pads, NOT big square terrain slabs.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR IDENTITIES:
row 1 col 1: butcher shop, two-story warm red-brick corner store, clay-tile gabled roof with chimney, red-and-cream striped awning, meat displayed behind storefront glass, small hanging cleaver emblem without letters, simple pots.
row 1 col 2: hardware shop, one-story cream plaster and timber store, slate pitched roof and chimney, tall glazed shop windows and central timber door, hanging hammer emblem without letters, barrel and small tools/crates.
row 1 col 3: florist shop, one-story cream plaster cottage store, dark sage-green pitched roof and glazed porch/lean-to, abundant modest pots of flowers in muted pink/yellow/white, hanging flower baskets.
row 2 col 1: post office, compact two-story pale limestone building, green tiled roof, orderly dark glazed windows and central recessed door, small round red street postbox by steps, subtle envelope emblem without writing.
row 2 col 2: bank, stately compact two-story cream limestone building, deep green hipped roof, central classical triangular entrance pediment on four columns, dark green entrance door, front stone steps, modest shrubs.
row 2 col 3: hotel, elegant compact three-story red-brick townhouse, dark slate mansard roof with three small dormer windows and two chimneys, stone window surrounds, dark glazed windows, gold/brass entrance canopy, a few flower boxes.
row 3 col 1: vehicle repair garage, low single-story red brick workshop, shallow dark slate hipped roof and vent, two side-by-side bays on left-facing facade, left bay open with red tool cabinet, right bay blue roller door, side industrial window, tiny concrete driveway.
row 3 col 2: barber shop, small single-story cream plaster storefront with blue-green tiled gabled roof and chimney, glazed wood-framed window, green canvas awning, one barber pole by glazed door, wooden bench and pots.
row 3 col 3: EMPTY transparent cell.
Do not add typography, letters, words, labels, numbers, vehicles, people, borders, watermarks or camera guide lines. Keep all eight identities distinct. Preserve enough safe transparent gutters so an automated alpha-preserving atlas packer can register complete cutouts without trimming any roofs.
